description: Implement ApplianceService for CRUD operations and StorageService for SharedPreferences persistence. Load/save appliances and electricity rate. Create 6 sample appliances on first run. Depends on FEAT-001 models.
steps: Create lib/services/storage_service.dart - manages SharedPreferences for appliances (key: 'appliances' as JSON list), electricity rate (key: 'electricity_rate', default 12.0 PHP/kWh), initialization
Implement StorageService.loadAppliances() - reads from SharedPreferences, parses JSON, returns List<Appliance>
Implement StorageService.saveAppliances(List<Appliance>) - writes to SharedPreferences as JSON
Implement StorageService.getElectricityRate() - returns rate or default 12.0
Create lib/services/appliance_service.dart - manages appliance CRUD using StorageService
Implement ApplianceService.getById(String id) - returns single appliance

Implement ApplianceService.initializeSampleAppliances() - creates 6 sample appliances (fan 70W, light 15W, TV 100W, refrigerator 150W, rice cooker 1000W, AC 2500W) with default schedules (7 days, 4-8 hours)
Create pub/uuid dependency in pubspec.yaml for ID generation
acceptance_criteria: StorageService saves and loads appliances persistently
Sample appliances initialized on first run with realistic wattages and schedules
All appliance changes persisted to SharedPreferences
Flutter analyze shows no errors in service files
verification: Run: flutter pub get — dependencies added (uuid, shared_preferences)
Run: flutter analyze lib/services/storage_service.dart lib/services/appliance_service.dart — no errors
Manually verify: create a simple test widget that loads, prints appliances from storage to console, see 6 sample appliances logged
